findings.reason: Step 1.3 derives the displayed coadjoint formula only for charges in the image of the cotangent moment map. It does not prove the formula on arbitrary (P,J) in the dual space, as the statement and downstream orbit claims require. Derive it from the semidirect-product adjoint action and the dual pairing.

Steps 1.1–2.1 use the full coadjoint action on arbitrary charge points to prove invariant preservation and orbit classification. The moment-map supplier currently establishes the formula only on its image; the smallest missing support is the coadjoint formula on the full dual.

Steps 3.1 and 4.1 require the full dual action and a descended Poincare action on the shell quotient. H8 establishes the characteristic-line quotient but does not prove that the action preserves the shell and fibres or that its fundamental fields project to the quotient. Step 1.1 also uses p_b for a charge-space point without explicitly identifying it with the defined P_b or constructing the rest-frame position representative.

With S only C3, the maps used in the two inverse-function arguments are C2. The cited inverse-function supplier assumes a smooth map and concludes a smooth diffeomorphism. State and prove the C2-diffeomorphism conclusion with the matching regularity result, or supply stronger regularity for S.
V is called smooth but its domain is not stated, although V(r^2) is used for Lorentzian r^2 values in R. Specify V as a smooth map on R, or on an open domain containing the values used.
